item.text:
Implemented a complete Rust 2021 project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), with the entrypoint at [test7.rs](/output/test7.rs) and modular library code in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/color.rs](/output/src/color.rs), [src/converter.rs](/output/src/converter.rs), [src/parsing.rs](/output/src/parsing.rs), and [src/formatting.rs](/output/src/formatting.rs).

The behavior matches the supplied C++ binary exactly, including the CLI quirk: only `r1 g1 b1 r2 g2` are read from the first five user args, the sixth user arg becomes `ratio`, `b2` always stays at its default `0.1`, and any seventh arg is ignored. I compiled it with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc test7.rs -O -o test7`; the executable is at `/output/test7`. Verification matched `/workspace/dataset/test7_executable` on the provided examples, edge cases, and 200 randomized comparisons.
